title: Second-Order Taylor Polynomial of an Exponential-Trigonometric Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the second-order Taylor polynomial P_2(x, y) for f(x, y) = exp(x) cos(y) about (0, 0).

steps.title: Compute Partial Derivatives Through Order 2 at (0, 0)
steps.mathExpression: f(0, 0) = 1; \quad f_x = e^x\cos y \implies 1; \quad f_y = -e^x\sin y \implies 0

steps.title: Evaluate Second-Order Partials at (0, 0)
steps.mathExpression: f_{xx} = e^x\cos y \implies 1; \quad f_{xy} = -e^x\sin y \implies 0; \quad f_{yy} = -e^x\cos y \implies -1
steps.explanation: Differentiate to obtain all second partial derivatives.
